million_key_tests.scenario: one million rotating anonymous Authorization headers

memory_and_work_bounds.scope: Structural entry/index bounds, concurrency and expiry assertions; not a standalone process-RSS benchmark.
memory_and_work_bounds.request_expiry_work: At most 16 indexed expired entries at capacity, plus the requested key; no full-map traversal.
memory_and_work_bounds.scheduled_expiry_work: At most 1024 entries per store per one-second task invocation.
memory_and_work_bounds.capacity_admission: Keep live protection; reject untracked subjects until a slot expires or a tracked login succeeds.
memory_and_work_bounds.keys: Fixed-length username/principal/IP digests or immutable numeric account/token IDs; raw Authorization headers are not retained.

bounded_limiters.scope: Real packaged JAR, Spring Security and isolated H2. Synthetic ClamD replies and explicit loopback trusted native proxy headers; no external TLS/IdP/Docker runtime.

behavior.password_lockout: Existing account-wide five failures/15-minute policy retained; local form and Basic share the local realm, LDAP separate realm in same bounded store.
behavior.scan_identity: Post-authentication immutable local account ID or token ID; source-qualified external principal; anonymous IP fallback.
behavior.invalid_early_credentials: Rejected by authentication/TLS/CSRF before scan allocation; no scan is admitted.
behavior.full_store: New keys are throttled; tracked live budgets and existing authenticated browser sessions remain intact.
behavior.scan_rejection: 429 rate_limited with Retry-After and Cache-Control: no-store
behavior.counter_overflow: Rejected scan count saturates at limit + 1; deadline does not slide.

verification_limits.network_fixture: Current packaged checks use isolated H2 and a synthetic ClamD peer, with explicit loopback trusted native proxy headers where TLS identity is needed.
verification_limits.browser_ui: No new headless browser interaction run for #23; capacity fields exercised through generic configuration persistence/precedence and actual consumer tests. Configuration Center packaged HTTP checks passed.
verification_limits.external_identities: No live remote LDAP/OIDC server in current validation; source-qualified principal identity behavior tested with synthetic authentication.
verification_limits.docker_and_native_clamav: Not rerun for #23; retained earlier reports keep their original scope.
verification_limits.external_sql: Current packaged state uses H2. Existing schema/probe tests run in Maven; no new live external SQL deployment.
verification_limits.per_instance: Caches reset on restart and are not shared across replicas; no supported distributed session/queue/limiter cluster added.
verification_limits.saturation_availability: A flood can temporarily reject a legitimate untracked account until a slot is released. Defaults are 10000 per store; capacity warnings are bounded and ingress abuse controls remain appropriate.
verification_limits.password_delay: Existing fixed five-attempt/15-minute policy retained; no progressive sleep/backoff mechanism is introduced.
